import os,subprocess,pathlib,json
for trial in [1,2,3]:
    for build in (['baseline','candidate'] if trial%2 else ['candidate','baseline']):
        output=f'/tmp/canoli-pen-paired-{build}-{trial}'
        env=dict(os.environ,CANOLI_VECTOR_FIXTURES='/tmp/canoli-vector-fixtures',CANOLI_VECTOR_TOOL='pen',CANOLI_VECTOR_ROUNDS='1',CANOLI_VECTOR_OUTPUT=output,CANOLI_VECTOR_URL='http://127.0.0.1:4183/' if build=='baseline' else 'http://127.0.0.1:4173/')
        env.pop('CANOLI_VECTOR_CASES',None);env.pop('CANOLI_VECTOR_PROFILE',None)
        with open(output+'.log','w') as log:subprocess.run(['node','--import','tsx','scripts/benchmark-vector-input.mjs'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
        report=json.loads(pathlib.Path(output+'/report.json').read_text())
        print(json.dumps({'build':build,'trial':trial,'results':{r['fixture']['id']:{'p95':round(r['p95Ms'],2),'tasks':[t['duration'] for t in r['longTasks']]} for r in report['reports']}}),flush=True)
for build in ['baseline','candidate']:
    output=f'/tmp/canoli-pen-repeat-{build}'
    env=dict(os.environ,CANOLI_VECTOR_FIXTURES='/tmp/canoli-vector-fixtures',CANOLI_VECTOR_TOOL='pen',CANOLI_VECTOR_ROUNDS='3',CANOLI_VECTOR_CASES='paths-1000,curves-200',CANOLI_VECTOR_OUTPUT=output,CANOLI_VECTOR_URL='http://127.0.0.1:4183/' if build=='baseline' else 'http://127.0.0.1:4173/')
    with open(output+'.log','w') as log:subprocess.run(['node','--import','tsx','scripts/benchmark-vector-input.mjs'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    report=json.loads(pathlib.Path(output+'/report.json').read_text())
    print(json.dumps({'build':build,'repeat':True,'results':{r['fixture']['id']:{'p95':round(r['p95Ms'],2),'blocks':r['blockP95Ms'],'taskCount':len(r['longTasks'])} for r in report['reports']}}),flush=True)

failureHistory: A native SVG diagnostic found an 18 px shift for 1e10 local coordinates with opposing translation. Final code falls back to the earlier absolute-coordinate path outside a conservative CSS-pixel precision envelope; final raster tests cover that case and a zoom-driven fast/fallback transition. A 129-pass broad run was intentionally stopped with two skipped cases for this correction, and is not final coverage.

The first 1000-path isolated setup was correctly rejected by the existing 40000-value command complexity limit; no editing evidence came from that rejected setup. Native constructor-built projects supply larger fixtures without changing the trust boundary.
